additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477034-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P3 170000408] Logs'check CRM:02681001402
additional_info.body:
Dear
Filomena
,
Thank you for reaching out.
Following your request and after our checks, we observed that at the beginning the EV request was 0, as shown in the attached screenshot. Additionally, after the  handshake, the charger was not able to reach the fast shadow cable, but this issue was only temporary.
Afterward, the charger was able to reach it again. The root cause of the failed charging session was related to a faulty cable sensor, as shown in the screenshot. Currently, no errors are flagged.
We will continue monitoring the charger, and if the error appears again, we will take the necessary actions to resolve the issue.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
